itens.trecho: Um clássico do terror. Este é um clássico de terror indispensável, que conta como um ex-professor se muda com a sua esposa e filho para um hotel de luxo nas montanhas, onde irá trabalhar como zelador nos meses de Inverno, em que o hotel fica fechado e isolado pela neve.

If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :) With Doctor Sleep, an almost 40-year sequel to The Shining, being released this week, now it’s the perfect time to revisit one of the greatest horror movies of all-time, as well as one of the most influential directors ever, Stanley Kubrick. I know, I know… Spoiler-free?
This rum is red, man! In spite of author Stephen King not being happy with Stanley Kubrick's adaptation of his novel, The Shining (1980) has proved to be a critical and commercial darling.
